title: Belkin 45W PD Charger Dock with USB-A, USB-C & HDMI

comparisons.notes: Belkin AVC010TTBK Connect 46.5W multi-port power hub, same model; listed in stock

writeup: Belkin's compact power hub (model AVC010TTBK) is new on Woot for $24.99. It runs one USB-C laptop or a Nintendo Switch off a single brick with USB-C PD, USB-A and HDMI out, which makes it a neat travel or desk dock. OfficeWorld lists the same model at $59.99.
amazon_match_notes: Woot page Asin B09MG37TN1; Amazon title 'Belkin 45W PD Charger Dock with USB-A, USB-C & HDMI' matches Woot title exactly
